body: Rows left partial in docsi/plans/compare/better-auth/core.md for the owner: (1) cookie attributes that weaken (HttpOnly/Secure off, no __Host- prefix) as an escape hatch with a start-up warning? rows advanced.cookies, defaultCookieAttributes; (2) accountLinking.requireLocalEmailVerified=false (link to an unverified local address); (3) updateEmailWithoutVerification for a verified address; (4) updateUser additionalFields through POST /auth/profile with per-column validation; (5) declarative plugin schema (fields, indexes) instead of per-engine DDL; (6) a session-stored locale field; (7) Discord/community channel (transport contributing). Not built for time: VK refresh needs device_id kept with the tokens (providers.md), account.storeStateStrategy cookie mode (core.md).
